description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Microsoft is hiring a Software Engineer for the Entra Admin Management UX team. The role builds and operates the Entra Admin Center and secure, accessible, AI-powered identity and access administration experiences, while contributing to frontend standards, shared UX libraries, and cloud services.
Frontend Software Engineer building enterprise identity and access administration experiences, shared UX libraries, and secure cloud services

Responsibilities:
• Builds the Entra Admin Center, the primary platform for identity and access administration
• Creates secure, intuitive, and AI-powered admin experiences for enterprise customers
• Leads frontend engineering standards and shared UX libraries across Entra
• Builds and operates scalable, secure, and accessible cloud services and user experiences
• Partners with engineers, architects, designers, and product managers to deliver customer value
• Develops reusable components and AI-first capabilities to improve quality and speed
• Collaborates across Microsoft teams to deliver new features and platform improvements

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience
• Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role
• Experience designing, coding, and troubleshooting cloud-based software
• Skilled in analyzing and solving problems using query languages and tools such as Kusto
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills across disciplines, levels, and product teams
• Willingness and ability to learn new skills quickly
• Self-starting attitude, excited to make things happen in new and ambiguous situations
• Proficient in backend technologies and cloud-based architectures to build large-scale distributed systems and AI/ML experience

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical field AND 1+ year(s) technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python
• OR Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Rust, or Python
• OR equivalent experience
